China School of Mechanical and Engineering, Jiangnan University have published papers on Scalar or longitudinal waves. This is fourth paper i found published on Scalar waves by official government bodies of US, Russia and China and their universities.

Author

Jiang Jianzhong

School of Mechanical and Engineering, Jiangnan University, Wuxi 214122, China
(He is listed as the corresponding author, Ph.D., Associate Professor, with research interests in energy medicine and energy drink development.)

Summary of the Paper

This theoretical paper proposes a model for Longitudinal Electromagnetic (LEM) waves (also called electric P-waves), which differ from conventional transverse electromagnetic (TEM) waves. The author argues that by reintroducing "longitudinal wave terms" into Maxwell's equations — specifically modifying Faraday’s law and the total current law to include scalar electric field and vortex magnetic field components — one can derive a consistent mathematical description of LEM waves in conductive media (especially good conductors like metals).

Key ideas include:

LEM waves propagate longitudinally (along the direction of travel) rather than transversely.

They arise from the mutual induction between a scalar electric field (non-vortex/active) and a vortex magnetic field (passive).

In good conductors, the model predicts unusual properties:

Superluminal phase velocity (potentially ~10¹⁰ m/s for the electric component)
Very high frequency (~10¹⁷ Hz in metals)

Excellent penetration through conductive materials and human tissue (described as "high-frequency transparency")

Ability to absorb "free energy" from the vacuum/zero-point energy via vortex interactions, with claimed energy amplification on the order of 10⁴ compared to input TEM waves

The paper suggests a cyclic conversion process resembling a "singularity" that absorbs magnetic energy (black hole-like) and potentially releases it (white hole-like).

It establishes a constraint relation between LEM and TEM wave speeds: V_ez / V_B = 1/(μϵ) (where V_ez is the LEM velocity and V_B relates to TEM-like vortex propagation).

Applications Proposed

The paper highlights potential uses in:

-Medicine (harmless deep tissue penetration for energy-based treatments)

-Wireless power transmission

-Free/zero-point energy harvesting
